label: circumjovial-100k
name: Circumjovial
text: They're only raising concerns about the frontier-level models, not lobbying to ban open weight models. Besides, Kimi K3 would take about $100,000 worth of hardware for someone to run at home. Nobody is gonna do that anyway so it's moot. There ARE real security concerns with a model as powerful as Kimi K3 being available to well-funded malicious adversaries. This is all rather overblown, and, ultimately, the letter itself means and obligates nothing.
